title: Hospital Nurse Reception Party, 1970s Vintage B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A candid black and white photograph from around 1970 depicting a workplace gathering or retirement reception for medical staff. Two nurses wearing white uniforms—one an Asian woman wearing a traditional starched nurse cap, and the other an African American woman—stand near a party table featuring a decorated sheet cake. On the right, a woman in a floral sleeveless dress ladles punch from a cut-glass bowl into paper cups.
